manager_second_author.community_label: Community Check is the mobile visible label for stored/API community_review; community_check is not the status enum.
manager_second_author.api_predicate: PUT /verse-audio/{projectUnitId}/{bibleTextId} (not POST) requires authenticateUser + VerseAudio EDIT. EDIT resolves assignment by verse, then ChapterAssignmentPolicy.edit. Existing content:assign with scope{orgId:assignment.organizationId,projectId:assignment.projectId} returns true exactly for POST_PEER_STATUSES. Manager branch does not require assignedUserId/peerCheckerId ownership; effective grant must match project/org or be global per authorize(). Draft, peer_check, not_started and complete return false for manager branch.
manager_second_author.mobile_gate: RecordTab does not impose separate PM/read-only role gate. captureDisabled = missing bibleTextId OR original-drafter-on-open-peer-check block OR Complete stage lock; NewTake also requires under5 own-take cap (or valid pericope span). At community_review and later non-Complete stages, stage lock=false and peer block=false. Mic permission, source text and capture-ready unit must be satisfied. Use Verse for simplest fixture; no need preference mutation.
manager_second_author.important_capture_side_effect_caveat: useVerseAudio stop() currently attempts normal auto-claim whenever assignedUserId is null, without passing status into chapterClaim. At post-peer unassigned stages API manager claim is denied (content:assign managers cannot self-claim). The claim failure is caught after the take is persisted; it does not change API upload edit permission. Do not interpret such a claim error as audio authorization failure or force a claim. Source-only risk to observe on disposable fixture, not a confirmed runtime defect.
